name: origins-of-life-vent
title: Origins-of-life vent campaign
lead:
The origin of cells, treated not as a single spark but as a staged sequence of nonequilibrium
transitions at an alkaline hydrothermal vent — each one a falsifiable step a simulation can pass or
fail. The guiding hypothesis is the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of life: that the vent–ocean
interface hands a nascent cell its first free-energy source (a natural proton gradient across thin
mineral walls), its first reduced carbon (H2-driven CO2 reduction), and a place to concentrate and
enclose that chemistry — before the cell evolves its own membranes, pumps and genes. The campaign
builds that vent from real geochemistry upward (serpentinization, reactive transport, H2-driven
carbon fixation, self-amplifying networks) and runs the classical favorable and the 2026 unfavorable
scenarios head to head rather than assuming either. Each stage is a coupled Vivarium composite of
genuine simulators (PHREEQC, FiPy, eQuilibrator, libRoadRunner) under explicit conservation contracts.
The first three stages — through reduced-carbon protometabolism — are built, run, and accepted; the
remaining stages toward a compartmentalized, bioenergetically autonomous protocell are designed and
waiting to run.

at_a_glance.role: The vent a cell would form in — validated geochemical/spatial testbed (no origin claim yet)
The cell's first carbon — H2-driven CO2 reduction; reproduce lab benchmarks; map the flux region
The first metabolism — reaction-network persistence and autocatalysis under flow
Becoming an individual — concentration/retention crosses persistence thresholds (milestone end)
The first boundary — amphiphile compartments give retention without isolation
Owning its energy — selection internalizes the vent's proton-gradient bioenergetics
The first heredity — competing inheritance modules; heredity must earn its keep
Before LUCA — population-level emergence vs single-lineage reconstruction
Leaving home — the minimum innovation set for an autonomous cell off-gradient
Adversarial control: the gates must reject generic non-vent chemistry

question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, or heredity by assumption?
hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.

executive.what_is_this: A staged, falsifiable Vivarium campaign testing the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of cells — treating a cellular origin as coupled transitions from geochemistry to bioenergetic autonomy, grounded in serpentinization-driven alkaline hydrothermal vents, with explicit competing scenarios.
executive.verdict: In progress — the full pre-genetic to early-genetic arc is complete and passing. og-00 (geochemical/spatial testbed), og-01 (geology -> reduced carbon, favorable vs. Tutolo-2026 arms), og-02 (reduced carbon -> protometabolism), og-03 (dilution -> localized individuals), og-04 (mineral compartments -> protocells), og-05 (environmental -> internal bioenergetics) and og-06 (chemistry -> heredity) are built on real simulators, run, and pass their pre-stated gates with conservation held to machine precision. The adversarial generic-nonequilibrium control runs and PASSES by rejection — every discriminating gate rejects a vent-feature-ablated control while the vent passes, so the gates are falsifiable and vent-specific. og-07 and og-08 remain designed but not yet run.
executive.verdict_detail: 10 member studies (Campaigns 0-VIII + an adversarial control) wired into a DAG. Stages 0-6 are complete — each runs a coupled Vivarium composite of real tools (PHREEQC + FiPy; eQuilibrator + FiPy; libRoadRunner; a FiPy thermal trap; amphiphile self-assembly; bioenergetic internalization; an agent-based heredity lineage) and passes its conservation and acceptance behavior tests. og-06's compositional-heredity headline ('heredity need not presume RNA') is seed-robust (8/8 seeds). The adversarial generic-nonequilibrium control (og-adv) runs and passes by rejection — all five discriminating gates reject a vent-feature-ablated control (min margin 1.8 decades) while the vent passes all five. og-07 (ecology before LUCA) and og-08 (escape from the vent) remain at Design with contracts (ports + conservation invariants) and behavior tests derived from their acceptance gates.
decisions_resolved: Baseline parameterization: run BOTH arms — classical favorable (Russell/Lane/Sojo) and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment (Tutolo/Jackson) — so the campaign adjudicates rather than assumes. Implemented in og-01.

Primary geochemistry engine: real PHREEQC (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat), which fields the Lost City pH endmember once peridotite (not dunite) is reacted. Reaktoro was conda-only and off the uv path.
Build order: geochemistry + transport first (og-00/og-01), then the reaction network (og-02) — not a thin end-to-end skeleton. This put a real composite in the workbench at stage 0.

Heredity strategy for og-06: compare all modules without presuming RNA. og-06's agent-based lineage grades RNA-like template, compositional (GARD), a template-focused hybrid and a non-heritable control head-to-head; compositional and hybrid heredity persist length-independently (functional persistence ~0.88, seed-robust 8/8) where a long low-fidelity template suffers the Eigen length catastrophe — so heredity need NOT presume a long high-fidelity RNA template.

decisions_needed.question: Publication milestone: close the first paper at the pre-genetic arc (og-00 -> og-03) or extend through the early-genetic arc (og-04 protocells -> og-06 heredity)?
decisions_needed.context: og-00 -> og-06 have now all run and passed, so both scopes are available. The pre-genetic arc (og-00->03: a precipitating interface retaining a persistent protometabolic carbon flux, then localized individuals) is the tightest standalone story; extending through og-04-06 adds membrane compartmentation, bioenergetic internalization and the agent-based heredity result. Editorial scope call.

scientific_argument.main_claim: Cells could have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents — the vent–ocean interface supplies, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, self-amplifying chemistry, concentration, compartmentation and bioenergetic internalization a protocell needs, and each step is an independently falsifiable nonequilibrium transition a Vivarium simulation can pass or fail, so simulations adjudicate among scenarios rather than illustrate one story.
evidence_for: H2-dependent mineral-catalyzed CO2 fixation (Preiner, Varma, Huber)
pH-gradient-driven CO2 reduction with isotope controls (Hudson, Altair)
thermophoretic concentration in pores (Baaske, Mast & Braun)
evidence_against: in-situ pH/sulfur/longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume (Tutolo 2026; Jackson 2016)
no validated vent pathway spans to open-ended heredity (Module J)
lab yields are not Hadean environmental concentrations
caveats: Stages 0–2 are complete and accepted; stages 3–8 and the adversarial control are designed but not yet run. Every quantitative anchor is laboratory/field provenance, not a Hadean environmental concentration.

key_claims.claim: Alkaline hydrothermal vents sustain a natural proton gradient across thin inorganic (Fe/Ni-sulfide) walls — a geologically free energy source a nascent cell could tap before evolving its own membrane and pumps.
Serpentinization of olivine delivers a sustained supply of H2, the reducing power that drives prebiotic chemistry at the vent.
That H2 reduces CO2 to organic carbon on native-metal and mineral catalysts without enzymes, reproducing the acetyl-CoA–like chemistry thought ancestral to life.
Nonenzymatic reaction networks (reductive-TCA fragments) can persist and self-amplify under continuous vent flow, a precursor to metabolism.
Thermal gradients in vent pores concentrate molecules by thermophoresis — a route to localized, individual-like accumulations against dilution.
Fatty-acid vesicles can assemble and persist under vent-like temperature and pH, giving the chemistry a compartment.
The classical favorable picture is contested — in-situ pH, sulfide availability and vent longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume, so each step is run against that challenge.

studies.name: og-00-vent-reactor-baseline
studies.title: Vent reactor baseline (Campaign 0)
studies.question: Can a Lost City–like, serpentinization-fed vent–ocean interface reproduce observed fluid mixing, heat transport, mineral precipitation and H2/alkalinity delivery under field-constrained conditions — with no origin-of-life claim?

resolved_uncertainties: The Lost City high-pH endmember is the peridotite Ca-OH buffer (not the olivine brucite buffer).
remaining_uncertainties: Sensitivity to the olivine/pyroxene ratio and to seawater-mixing dilution of the endmember.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Sweep pyroxene_fraction and mixing dilution to bound the pH endmember.

findings.statement: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).
findings.explanation: Real PHREEQC peridotite serpentinization (Ca-OH endmember) + FiPy transport; pH is a genuine speciation result, not tuned.

findings.statement: Serpentinization delivers a sustained H2 reducing-power flux (min 2.2e-4 mol/s over the back half of the run).

evidence.observed: 2.2e-4 mol/s

findings.statement: PHREEQC charge balance and FiPy FVM spatial-flux divergence are conserved to machine epsilon (<1e-6 and ~5e-16).

evidence.observed: |charge|=0, |flux residual|=5e-16

findings.statement: The Lost City pH endmember required reacting PERIDOTITE (olivine+pyroxene), not dunite — Ca released once Mg is consumed buffers the fluid to pH ~9.5.
findings.explanation: Olivine-only buffers at ~7.8 (brucite); adding diopside gives the Ca-OH endmember that reproduces field pH.

findings.statement: The vent wall convects. Solving Darcy–Boussinesq porous flow (a stream-function Poisson ∇²ψ = −buoyancy·∂T/∂x on the real FiPy mesh) gives a buoyant recirculation cell — the hot alkaline conduit rises, the cold ocean sinks, convective velocities ~5× the background upflow (Peclet ~8) — rather than a prescribed uniform upflow. The recirculation mixes cold ocean inward, settling the outlet ~8 °C cooler (59 → 51 °C) while staying inside the Lost City window; flux conservation is preserved to machine epsilon.

evidence.observed: recirculation cell (cold-left sinks, hot-right rises); vmax ~5× background; outlet 50.6 °C

findings.explanation: FipyReactiveTransportProcess now solves the stream function each step and advects T + solute with the divergence-free Darcy velocity (u=∂ψ/∂y, v=−∂ψ/∂x + upflow); ψ contours are the streamlines the cross-section viz overlays. buoyancy=0 recovers the old constant upflow.

studies.claim: A real PHREEQC + FiPy serpentinization reactor settles into the Lost City window (T 51 °C, pH 9.37) with sustained H2 and exact mass/charge/spatial-flux conservation.

biological_validation.basis: No origin-of-life claim at this stage — this is a geochemical/spatial testbed only.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real speciation reproduces the field T/pH window AND reveals the peridotite Ca-OH endmember requirement — a mechanistic gain over the tuned box.

derived.insight: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).

studies.name: og-01-geology-to-reduced-carbon
studies.title: Geology to reduced carbon (Campaign I)
studies.question: Which combinations of T, pH, pressure, H2, CO2 and mineralogy generate sustained net organic-carbon flux across the interface — reproducing Hudson/Preiner/Altair regimes before any extrapolation?

resolved_uncertainties: A viable favorable regime exists; formate strictly requires the pH gradient + H2 + catalyst.

The (vent pH × H2) fixation landscape is now mapped (14×14 sweep, open-flow sustained throughput), not inferred from a single run — the favorable region is broadly productive and scales with both the gradient and H2.
remaining_uncertainties: The continuous gradient_efficiency threshold between the favorable and Tutolo-collapse regimes (the phase map shows two levels; a third axis would resolve the boundary).

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Extend the phase map with T and pressure facets and a continuous gradient_efficiency axis to locate the viable-fixation boundary.

findings.statement: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

evidence.observed: formate=200 mM, acetate=100 µM, pyruvate=10 µM

findings.explanation: Real eQuilibrator ΔG'-gated, lab-calibrated mineral kinetics over the pH gradient.

findings.statement: Formate is present with the pH-gradient proton-motive force and collapses to <1 mM in every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst).

evidence.observed: favorable 200 mM; all controls <1 mM

findings.statement: The Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm collapses the usable proton-motive gradient (pmf 427 → 43 mV), the discriminating test the campaign must survive.

evidence.observed: favorable pmf 427 mV vs Tutolo 43 mV

findings.explanation: Real FiPy Nernst-Planck electrodiffusion with a gradient_efficiency knob (1.0 favorable, 0.1 Tutolo).

findings.statement: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' is logged every step and makes feasibility explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' ≥ 0 — genuine product inhibition).

Carbon fixation SPENDS the proton gradient — a conserved proton budget (≈2 H⁺ per carbon) draws the loaded pmf down ~40% below the open-circuit 427 mV under load, then relaxes as products saturate. The gradient does work and is consumed, not merely correlated with reduction.

evidence.observed: pmf open-circuit 427 mV sags to ~250 mV (charge 0.60) at peak fixation, recovers to 427 mV

findings.explanation: A ProtonBudgetProcess integrates reservoir = supply − protons_per_carbon·carbon_flux − leak·reservoir; fixation reads the loaded pmf = pmf_open·(reservoir/capacity), closing the respiratory-control feedback.

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over the (vent pH × dissolved H₂) plane maps the carbon-fixation landscape, not a single run. In the open-flow reactor, sustained reduced-carbon throughput scales with both the pH gradient and H₂ (6.4 → 24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s; steady pool 7–28 mM); the Tutolo-2026 gradient collapse roughly halves it on the same axes, and the no-gradient / no-catalyst / no-H₂ controls zero it. The favorable region is broadly productive — the sharp dependence is on a SUSTAINED gradient, not on sitting at one pH/H₂ point.

evidence.observed: favorable 6.4–24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s vs Tutolo 2.2–15; controls 0

findings.explanation: 14×14 sweep of the real open-flow composite (pH 7–11 × H₂ 0.1–20 mM, exponential washout) reduced to sustained throughput per point; rendered as the carbon-fixation phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phase_grid.py.

studies.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S reproduces the Preiner/Hudson lab yields and net organic-carbon flux in a bounded favorable regime; the Tutolo-2026 arm shows the usable proton-motive gradient collapses at in-situ T/P, zeroing the flux.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Preiner/Hudson organic-carbon benchmarks with the controls behaving correctly.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real thermodynamics (eQuilibrator) + electrochemistry (FiPy NPP) explain both the favorable regime and the Tutolo collapse.

derived.insight: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

simulations.name: Geology to reduced carbon (Campaign I) — favorable

studies.name: og-02-reduced-carbon-to-protometabolism
studies.title: Reduced carbon to protometabolism (Campaign II)
studies.question: Under continuous feed and washout, do reaction subnetworks become self-reinforcing — persistent cycles, flux amplification, product reuse, autocatalytic motifs — without imposed product accumulation?

resolved_uncertainties: A curated rTCA-fragment network under flow sustains throughput AND an autocatalytic motif.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether an acetyl-CoA-pathway arm cross-feeds or competes with the rTCA core.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Add the acetyl-CoA-pathway fragments as a parallel arm and test cross-feeding.

findings.statement: The rTCA-fragment network sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput (~9e-4 mol/s) under continuous feed + washout, with no imposed product accumulation.

evidence.observed: 9e-4 mol/s

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner SBML CSTR — throughput is a steady balance of production and washout.

findings.statement: An autocatalytic motif emerges — OAA self-amplifies ~60× (gain ~3 steady, ~29 peak) via the lumped reductive-TCA turn; a no-CO2 control collapses it.

evidence.observed: gain 29 peak / ~3 steady; control gain 0

findings.explanation: The reductive-TCA turn OAA+2CO2->2OAA+acetate doubles its own entry molecule per turn — genuine autocatalysis, not an imposed assumption.

findings.statement: Products form ONE connected reaction network (networkx connectivity), not disconnected one-offs.

evidence.observed: connected=1.0

findings.statement: A sweep over (feed CO₂ × washout rate) maps where the network IGNITES, not just that it does at one point. The autocatalytic hub (OAA) persists in a sharply bounded region — enough geological CO₂ in, slow enough washout (gain > 1) — and collapses to zero across a clean diagonal boundary when the feed is starved or the reactor flushed too fast. The favorable operating point sits well inside the ignition region; the gain=1 contour is the autocatalytic threshold.

evidence.observed: OAA hub 0 → 24 mM across the (feed × washout) plane; ignition bounded by gain=1

findings.explanation: 16×16 sweep of the real libRoadRunner composite reduced to the settled OAA pool, net throughput and gain; rendered as the ignition phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_gain_grid.py. Per-reaction fluxes are now read live from the engine (getReactionRates) so the network view is flux-weighted.

studies.claim: A curated rTCA-fragment network under continuous feed + washout sustains nonzero carbon throughput, exhibits an autocatalytic motif (OAA self-amplification, gain ~3), and forms a single connected reaction network — metabolism-like behavior emerging without imposed product accumulation.

biological_validation.basis: Emergent sustained throughput + autocatalysis + connectivity, with a no-CO2 control collapsing them.

explanatory_gain.basis: The genuine libRoadRunner ODE network shows WHY autocatalysis arises (the reductive-TCA turn doubles OAA).

derived.insight: The rTCA-fragment network sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput (~9e-4 mol/s) under continuous feed + washout, with no imposed product accumulation.

studies.name: og-03-dilution-to-localized-individuals
studies.title: Dilution to localized individuals (Campaign III)
studies.question: When do retention time and concentration cross the thresholds for network persistence, as pore morphology evolves via precipitation/dissolution?

resolved_uncertainties: A geometric threshold exists — favorable pores concentrate >10^8-fold while open/short pores wash through.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the og-02 autocatalytic network actually persists in the concentrated pocket vs well-mixed bulk.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Couple the og-02 rTCA network into the trapped pocket; map the retention-time persistence threshold.

findings.statement: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) reproduces Baaske-2007 extreme accumulation — ~10^8-fold enrichment (accumulation Péclet 18.4) — from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon.

evidence.observed: favorable Pe_acc 18.4 (enrichment ~9.6e7); residual ~2e-14

findings.explanation: ThermophoreticTrapProcess solves the steady accumulation column; enrichment = exp(beta·L) with beta from Soret × convection × confinement.

findings.statement: A localized individual forms only above a geometric threshold — an open pore (porosity→1) washes the feed through (enrichment ~1) and a 10× shorter pore enriches >100× less, mapping the washout region against the accumulation region.

evidence.observed: open-pore enrichment ~1; short pore >100x less than favorable

findings.explanation: Enrichment is exponential in pore length and vanishes with confinement — the dilution/localization boundary the campaign sought.

findings.statement: Localization MAKES the individual: coupling the real thermophoretic trap to the real og-02 network, a pore that enriches the feed ~23× lifts a dilute vent feed (CO₂ 5e-5 M) across og-02's ignition threshold — the autocatalytic hub ignites to ~1.6 mM OAA inside the pore, while the identical chemistry stays dead (OAA ≈ 0) in the well-mixed ocean. The metabolizing individual is a product of localization, not of new reactions.

evidence.observed: well-mixed OAA ≈ 0 mM vs in-pore OAA ≈ 1.6 mM at the same dilute feed; trap ×23

findings.explanation: Two real models coupled (FiPy thermophoretic trap enrichment → libRoadRunner rTCA network feed) and placed on og-02's ignition landscape: the trap moves the operating point from the washout region across the gain=1 threshold into the ignited region. Rendered as the pore-ignition coupling (Decision view).

studies.claim: A real FiPy thermal trap (thermophoresis + convection) concentrates a dilute vent feed >10^8-fold in a favorable pore (Baaske 2007), and the concentration collapses to ~1 in an open pore — the geometric threshold at which a localized "individual" forms.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Baaske-2007 >10^8-fold accumulation benchmark with controls collapsing to ~1.

explanatory_gain.basis: Real transport (thermophoresis + convection) explains both the extreme enrichment and the geometry threshold for localization.

derived.insight: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) reproduces Baaske-2007 extreme accumulation — ~10^8-fold enrichment (accumulation Péclet 18.4) — from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon.

studies.name: og-04-mineral-compartments-to-protocells
studies.title: Mineral compartments to protocells (Campaign IV)
studies.question: Do mixed-amphiphile organic boundaries enhance persistence without cutting the system off from geochemical energy?

resolved_uncertainties: A non-empty individuality-without-isolation region exists — mixed amphiphiles form selectively-permeable vesicles at vent conditions.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether enclosing the og-02 network in the vesicle actually improves its persistence over the open pore.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Enclose the og-02 rTCA network in the vesicle; compare in-compartment vs well-mixed persistence.

findings.statement: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

evidence.observed: mixed viable ~8000; single-fatty-acid viable 0 at 0.35 M salt

findings.explanation: ProtocellAssemblyProcess broadens the pH window + salt/divalent tolerance with the co-surfactant fraction (coarse-grained, Jordan-calibrated).

findings.statement: The viable compartments retain internal chemistry (retention 0.91) while staying permeable to the external gradient (access 1.0) — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region (product ≈ 0.90), the key requirement for a protocell that does not cut itself off from geochemical energy.

evidence.observed: retention 0.91 × access 1.0 ≈ 0.90

findings.explanation: Selective permeability — low effective permeability to large/charged internal metabolites, higher to small external resources.

findings.statement: Sweeping permeability (via temperature) traces the compartment through THREE regimes on the retention-access plane — too closed (retains but starves; low T), a viable window (individuality + access, peak ret×acc ≈ 0.91 at ~312 K), and too open (leaks; high T) before the membrane destabilizes entirely. Orthogonally, the viable SALT ceiling rises with co-surfactant fraction: vesicles survive at seawater salt (0.35 M) and beyond only above mix ≈ 0.4 — the Jordan mixed-amphiphile advantage as a bounded 2-D region, not a single point.

evidence.observed: retention 0.97→0 and access 0.71→1→0 across T; viable salt ceiling rises with mix_fraction

findings.explanation: Temperature sweep → retention-access arc; (mix × ionic strength) sweep → salt-tolerance feasibility map; rendered as the retention-access Decision view.

findings.statement: The parameter sweep exposed that an exact mix_fraction=0.0 is swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default (0.4), which would silently turn the single-fatty-acid control into a mixed-amphiphile run. The composite now clamps 0.0 to a negligible 1e-6 and reads mix_fraction via a state input, so the control is honored. (The study runner had already dodged it with 0.001.)
findings.explanation: A sweep axis starting at exactly 0.0 revealed the gotcha; the fix hardens the composite for any caller passing 0.0.

studies.claim: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles across the alkaline / seawater-salt window where single fatty acids fail (Jordan 2019), and those compartments retain internal chemistry while staying permeable to the gradient — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Jordan-2019 mixed-amphiphile window broadening (mixed forms vesicles at salt where single fatty acids fail).

explanatory_gain.basis: Physical chemistry (window + selective permeability) explains both vesicle formation and the retention-without-isolation tradeoff.

derived.insight: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

studies.name: og-05-environmental-to-internal-bioenergetics
studies.title: Environmental to internal bioenergetics (Campaign V)
studies.question: Can selection move from externally imposed gradients toward internally maintained electrochemical states (catalytic ion transport then pumping)?

resolved_uncertainties: Selection can internalize gradient generation as the external gradient falls, bounded by the Sojo leaky-membrane constraint.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise pump-efficiency threshold separating viable internalization from extinction.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Sweep catalyst_efficiency and decline_rate to map the viable-internalization boundary.

findings.statement: As the external geochemical gradient declines over the run, replicator selection drives the population from externally-driven (pump fraction ~0) to internalized gradient generation (pump fraction ~0.95) while persisting — the bioenergetic internalization is an evolutionary outcome, not a scripted upgrade.

evidence.observed: internalization 0.00 -> 0.95; survivors 1.0 at the collapsed gradient

findings.explanation: BioenergeticSelectionProcess replicator dynamics over a (permeability × pump) strategy grid with a Sojo leaky-membrane fitness; the declining gradient flips the winning strategy from leaky-external to tight-pump.

findings.statement: A weak pump cannot internalize — when the external gradient collapses, the weak-pump lineage goes extinct (survivors → 0) while the efficient-pump lineage persists. Internalization is only viable with a sufficiently efficient pump (the Sojo leaky-membrane constraint).

evidence.observed: efficient survivors 1.0 vs weak-pump survivors 0.0 at collapsed gradient

findings.explanation: Below a pump-efficiency threshold the internal-pump flux cannot beat its cost against the lost external coupling, so no strategy clears the survival floor.

findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by SOURCE (not just the net flux) shows the useful disequilibrium shifting from the external geochemical gradient to internally maintained power as the environment declines — the external share of the useful free energy falls from ~82% to ~1% over the run while the population persists. The organism comes to "own" its energy: the geochemical gradient becomes a resource it taps, not the scaffold that organizes it.

evidence.observed: external share of useful free energy 82% → 1% as external pmf 0.40 → 0.02 V; survivors 1.0

findings.explanation: The selection process now emits the population-mean provenance breakdown (external tap k_ext·pmf·P vs internal pump k_int·pump·eff·(1−P) vs maintenance cost); rendered as the stacked energy-provenance trajectory + the gradient-dependence curve (Decision view).

studies.claim: Under a declining external gradient, selection drives an efficient-pump population to internalize gradient generation (pump fraction 0→0.95) and persist, while a weak-pump lineage collapses — the Sojo-2014 leaky-membrane constraint on bioenergetic internalization.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Sojo-2014 constraint — internalization is viable only with a sufficiently efficient pump; a weak pump collapses at the transition.

explanatory_gain.basis: The evolutionary control loop explains both the internalization transition and its Sojo-bounded failure mode from the leaky-membrane fitness.

derived.insight: As the external geochemical gradient declines over the run, replicator selection drives the population from externally-driven (pump fraction ~0) to internalized gradient generation (pump fraction ~0.95) while persisting — the bioenergetic internalization is an evolutionary outcome, not a scripted upgrade.

studies.name: og-06-chemistry-to-heredity
studies.title: Chemistry to heredity (Campaign VI)
studies.question: Does inherited state improve persistence/throughput — comparing RNA-like, peptide-assisted, compositional and hybrid heredity — rather than template replication in isolation? (Do NOT presume RNA.)

resolved_uncertainties: Inheritance improves fitness above the Eigen error threshold and can be ranked across modules by an evidence-based head-to-head.
Heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity RNA template — compositional (GARD) and hybrid heredity persist length-independently above the non-heritable control.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether an inherited catalyst actually raises the og-02 network's metabolic throughput in-lineage.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Couple the winning heredity module to the og-02 rTCA network; measure inherited-catalyst throughput gain.

findings.statement: A high-fidelity heredity module (RNA-like, 30-mer, per-site fidelity 0.99 → whole-sequence Q=0.74) retains functional information (C/(C+E)=0.62) and achieves net-positive lineage fitness (0.38) after its replication cost, outscoring the non-heritable control whose function degrades away.

evidence.observed: RNA-like fitness 0.38 (retention 0.62) vs non-heritable ~0

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner quasispecies ODE; above the Eigen error threshold correct templates outreplicate the mutational error tail (Eigen 1971).

findings.statement: Heredity modules rank by an evidence-based head-to-head — RNA-like (0.38) beats the cheaper, lower-fidelity peptide module (0.24), and both beat non-inheritance — while a module below the error threshold (per-site 0.90 × 30-mer, Q=0.04) suffers the error catastrophe (retention 0, fitness −0.10).

evidence.observed: RNA-like 0.38 > peptide 0.24; low-fidelity retention 0, fitness -0.10

findings.explanation: Whole-sequence fidelity Q = per_site_fidelity^length sets the threshold; longer high-fidelity polymers retain more information but cost more to replicate.

findings.statement: An agent-based LINEAGE model (individuals inherit a chemical phenotype at fission into a real tree) re-derives the Eigen error threshold as a functional-persistence boundary in (per-site fidelity × length) space — AND shows that heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity template — compositional (GARD) and template-focused hybrid heredity persist at functional-persistence ~0.88 (seed-robust across 8 seeds, 0.875±0.006) INDEPENDENT of length, where a long low-fidelity template collapses; the non-heritable control loses the parent↔offspring correlation (realized heritability ~0.04–0.11 vs 0.92–0.99 for the heritable modules) and crashes to ~5 individuals.

evidence.observed: compositional persistence 0.875±0.006 across 8 seeds (heritability 0.92), hybrid ~0.88 (0.92) — length-independent; template needs Q=fidelity^length above threshold; non-heritable heritability ~0.04–0.11, collapses every seed

findings.explanation: Coarse-grained agent-based reproduction with explicit fidelity/cost/competition. Template inheritance ratchets (Eigen 1971, no back-mutation) so a long low-fidelity template loses information; compositional inheritance drifts by multinomial fission of an autocatalytic composition (GARD, Segré 2000) — length-independent, so it escapes the length catastrophe. The realized heritability (offspring↔parent φ slope) separates true inheritance from the non-heritable control.

studies.claim: An inherited chemical state improves lineage fitness above its replication cost when it clears the Eigen error threshold — but heredity need NOT presume a long high-fidelity RNA template. An agent-based lineage shows template heredity suffers the length catastrophe (Q=fidelity^length collapses with length) while compositional (GARD) and template-focused hybrid heredity persist length-independently (functional persistence ~0.88, seed-robust across 8 seeds) above the non-heritable control, which loses the parent↔offspring correlation and collapses. (A mean-field quasispecies arm still ranks a long high-fidelity template above a cheaper peptide module above non-inheritance when all clear the threshold.)

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the Eigen error threshold (inheritance pays above it, collapses below it) at both mean-field and individual-lineage level, ranks viable modules head-to-head, and shows non-template (compositional/hybrid) heredity persisting length-independently.

explanatory_gain.basis: Two independent engines — a quasispecies ODE and an agent-based lineage — both derive the fidelity × length error threshold from first principles, and the lineage additionally shows compositional/hybrid heredity escaping the length catastrophe (heredity need not presume RNA).

derived.insight: A high-fidelity heredity module (RNA-like, 30-mer, per-site fidelity 0.99 → whole-sequence Q=0.74) retains functional information (C/(C+E)=0.62) and achieves net-positive lineage fitness (0.38) after its replication cost, outscoring the non-heritable control whose function degrades away.

studies.name: og-07-ecology-before-luca
studies.title: Ecology before LUCA (Campaign VII)
studies.question: In connected pore networks with cross-feeding, parasitism, cooperation and horizontal exchange, what emergent capabilities arise — compared to ancestral reconstructions, without assuming LUCA is primitive?

resolved_uncertainties: Connected, heterogeneous populations develop functional redundancy (robustness) that isolated compartments do not — robustly across seeds.
That robustness is an emergent property of a bounded (diversity x exchange) region, not a monotone response to either knob alone.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the emergent cross-feeding chains map onto specific reductive-TCA / Wood-Ljungdahl byproduct exchanges when the compartments run the real og-02 network.
How parasite load and network topology (beyond a ring) shift the emergence boundary.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Instantiate the real og-02 libRoadRunner network per compartment for a small N and check the coarse-grained cross-feeding chains against metabolite exchange.
Carry the robust metacommunity into the escape-from-the-vent transition (dispersal to a fluctuating environment).

findings.statement: A connected metacommunity of 8 pore compartments, each carrying a sparse coarse-grained protometabolic capability vector (2 of 12 functions intrinsic), develops functional redundancy (robustness 0.667) through cross-feeding and horizontal transfer, well above the isolated counterfactual (0.500) run on the identical seeded assignment. Across an 8-seed sweep the connected arm (0.71±0.08) strictly beats the isolated arm (0.42±0.06) on every seed (min gain 0.17), so the redundancy is a product of connectivity, not of the capability assignment.

evidence.observed: connected robustness 0.71±0.08 vs isolated 0.42±0.06 across 8 seeds, 8/8 pass, min gain 0.17

findings.explanation: Coarse-grained deterministic metacommunity (reproduction, not wrapped ALife). Cross-feeding (a compartment expressing a capability its neighbour lacks supplies the byproduct) and horizontal transfer (the capability is copied from a donor) spread sparse intrinsic capabilities into redundant coverage across the ring; a capability held by >= 2 compartments survives a single-compartment loss. Acquired capability decays toward the intrinsic set, so it persists only while continuously supplied.

findings.statement: Robustness EMERGES only in a bounded corner of (cross-feeding exchange_rate x inter-compartment diversity). At low diversity the compartments are near-identical, so cross-feeding/HGT have nothing to share and robustness stays at the sparse intrinsic floor (~0.17-0.25 regardless of exchange); at low exchange a diverse-but-disconnected set holds a broad repertoire fragilely (each capability in one compartment, ~0.33-0.42); only where diversity >= ~0.4 AND exchange crosses ~0.2 does robustness climb to 0.58-0.83. The transition is a phase boundary, not a monotone response to either knob alone.

evidence.observed: robustness landscape over (exchange x diversity): emergence boundary at exchange~0.2, diversity~0.4; canonical operating point 0.667

findings.explanation: Cross-feeding scales as exchange_rate/connectivity and is deficit-driven (zero between identical compartments), so diversity is the raw material and exchange is the spreading mechanism; both are necessary. The sparse capability space (2 of 12 intrinsic per compartment) makes an isolated compartment functionally fragile, so redundancy must be BUILT by the metacommunity.

findings.statement: The metacommunity's collective capability repertoire overlaps the Weiss-2016 anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA core at 0.60 (canonical) and 0.70±0.14 across seeds. This is reported as a far-end BOUNDARY the emergent set approaches from below — a phylogenomic constraint on capabilities eventually acquired — and is explicitly NOT a fitting target; the model is never tuned toward it.

evidence.observed: collective LUCA-core overlap 0.60 canonical, 0.70±0.14 across 8 seeds (reported, not gated)

findings.explanation: The LUCA reconstruction (anaerobic, H2-dependent, CO2-fixing, FeS-rich; Weiss 2016, 355 protein families; Moody 2024, LUCA embedded in an ecosystem ~4.2 Ga) is a constraint on which capabilities the lineage eventually acquired, used as a boundary condition on the emergent repertoire rather than as evidence the first compartments were LUCA-like.

studies.claim: A connected metacommunity of heterogeneous pore compartments develops functional redundancy (robustness) that an isolated compartment cannot — cross-feeding and horizontal transfer spread coarse-grained protometabolic capabilities into >= 2-fold coverage, so most functions survive a single-compartment loss. Robustness EMERGES only in a bounded region of (cross-feeding exchange_rate x inter-compartment diversity) — too little diversity leaves nothing to share, too little exchange leaves a broad repertoire fragile. The collective repertoire's overlap with the anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA reconstruction is REPORTED as a far-end boundary the emergent set approaches (~0.6-0.7), not a target — LUCA constrains which capabilities are eventually acquired, not evidence the first compartments were LUCA-like.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the ecological expectation that connected, heterogeneous populations are more robust than isolated compartments (functional redundancy via cross-feeding + horizontal transfer), with the anaerobic LUCA reconstruction as a far-end boundary rather than an assumption.

explanatory_gain.basis: Identifies robustness as an EMERGENT property bounded in (diversity x exchange) space — a phase boundary, not a monotone response — and frames the LUCA overlap as a reported constraint, separating "capabilities eventually acquired" from "the first compartments were LUCA-like".

derived.insight: A connected metacommunity of 8 pore compartments, each carrying a sparse coarse-grained protometabolic capability vector (2 of 12 functions intrinsic), develops functional redundancy (robustness 0.667) through cross-feeding and horizontal transfer, well above the isolated counterfactual (0.500) run on the identical seeded assignment. Across an 8-seed sweep the connected arm (0.71±0.08) strictly beats the isolated arm (0.42±0.06) on every seed (min gain 0.17), so the redundancy is a product of connectivity, not of the capability assignment.

studies.name: og-08-escape-from-the-vent
studies.title: Escape from the vent (Campaign VIII)
studies.question: What is the minimum set of innovations required for autonomous persistence away from the geological reactor, as environmental support is relaxed?

resolved_uncertainties: Autonomy away from the vent requires an irreducible innovation set {pump, importer, heredity}, not a single innovation — each is necessary under withdrawing support.
Co-limitation (energy AND resources) is the structural reason the set is irreducible.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether a staged acquisition order (which innovation is acquired first) matters when support channels are withdrawn at different rates.

findings.statement: Under withdrawing geological support (external gradient, mineral access and feed all relaxed to zero), the full innovation set persists off-gradient (surviving fraction 1.0, net budget +0.36) while removing any single innovation collapses persistence to 0 — so the minimum robust set for autonomy is irreducible, {internal pump, resource importer, heredity}.

evidence.observed: full set survivors 1.0; -pump 0.0, -importer 0.0, -heredity 0.0

findings.explanation: Deterministic co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget; as support -> 0 the external tap and ambient substrate both vanish, so persistence needs an internal pump (energy) AND an importer (resource) at once, held by heredity (information maintenance).

findings.statement: The innovation set is irreducible precisely because the budget is co-limited — gross = min(energy, resource). A lone pump raises energy but the resource term still limits growth (and vice versa), so a half-equipped lineage pays an innovation's upkeep without a co-benefit; the survival frontier shows single knockouts needing MORE environmental support than even the bare control over part of the range.

evidence.observed: frontier: full persists to support 0; -pump 0.33, -heredity 0.44, none 0.48, -importer 0.59

findings.explanation: Liebig's law of the minimum — co-limitation means energy and resource cannot substitute for one another, so autonomy requires acquiring both independently of the vent (pump + importer) and holding that machinery (heredity).

findings.statement: Heredity is necessary not as an energy or resource term but as information maintenance — without it the adaptive machinery degrades over the run (machinery integrity 1.0 -> 0.007, an error-catastrophe decay), so the pump and importer cannot be held and the lineage collapses even though it carries them.

evidence.observed: -heredity: machinery integrity 0.007 at run end, survivors 0.0

findings.explanation: The heredity flag gates the per-step machinery decay; without it the innovation terms (pump, importer) scale toward zero as machinery is lost, so the budget falls below the survival floor.

studies.claim: Autonomy away from the geological reactor requires an irreducible innovation set — internal energy conversion (a pump), active resource import, and heredity to hold them. Because the lineage's budget is co-limited (it needs BOTH usable free energy AND usable resources, Liebig's minimum), a single innovation is a cost without a co-benefit; only the full set keeps the net budget above the survival floor as the external gradient, mineral access and feed are all withdrawn. A knockout sweep shows the full set persists off-gradient (surviving fraction 1.0) while removing any one innovation collapses persistence to 0 — so the minimum robust set for escaping the vent is {pump, importer, heredity}.

biological_validation.basis: Reproduces the alkaline-vent origin expectation — the first cells are vent-tied and escaping to free-living requires internalising energy generation (a pump), acquiring resources (an importer) and maintaining the machinery (heredity); each is shown necessary by knockout.

explanatory_gain.basis: Explains WHY autonomy requires a set rather than a single step — co-limitation (Liebig's minimum) makes energy and resource acquisition non-substitutable, so the minimum innovation set is irreducible.

derived.insight: Under withdrawing geological support (external gradient, mineral access and feed all relaxed to zero), the full innovation set persists off-gradient (surviving fraction 1.0, net budget +0.36) while removing any single innovation collapses persistence to 0 — so the minimum robust set for autonomy is irreducible, {internal pump, resource importer, heredity}.

studies.name: og-adv-generic-nonequilibrium
studies.title: Adversarial: generic nonequilibrium control
studies.question: Does a generic nonequilibrium chemical system with no vent-specific features (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration) pass the vent-specific gates? It SHOULD NOT.

resolved_uncertainties: The og-01/02/03 gates are vent-specific and falsifiable — a feature-ablated generic control is rejected by all five while the vent passes all five.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether broader non-vent scenario families (atmospheric/impact/surface chemistries) are also rejected.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Add a second adversarial family (e.g. an atmospheric-spark or impact-plume control) and confirm the gates reject it too.

findings.statement: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 vs 1e6 fold — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

evidence.observed: min rejection margin 1.84 decades (tightest gate: og-03 accumulation Péclet, generic 0.26 < 18); all 5 gates reject generic, vent passes all 5

findings.explanation: The vent features are PARAMETERS on the same real composites, so the control is a parameterization of the vent models, not a hand-tuned mock. No dissolved H2 → no CO2 reduction; no Fe/Ni/S interface → no abiotic carbon fixation; an open pore → no thermophoretic concentration.

findings.statement: The gates are vent-specific detectors, not generic nonequilibrium detectors — the vent passes where the control fails on each of the five gates. A PASS therefore certifies the vent mechanism (sustained H2 + Fe/Ni/S catalysis + pore concentration), falsifying the "the gates just measure any driven chemistry" objection.

evidence.observed: vent passes 5/5 gates; generic control fails 5/5 — pass-where-control-fails on every gate

findings.explanation: Falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the headline claims would be hollow if a feature-ablated control cleared the same bars. It does not.

findings.statement: Building the control exposed a latent control-integrity bug — catalyst_active=0 was silently swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default, so the no-catalyst control (here AND in og-01's cross-run gate) secretly ran WITH full catalyst. Clamping to 1e-6 honors the control; og-01's gates still pass (9/9 + both cross-run) with the now-truthful control.

evidence.observed: no-catalyst formate dropped from ~0.014 mM (catalyst silently on) to ~2e-8 mM (honored); og-01 still PASS

findings.explanation: Same gotcha as og-04's mix_fraction=0; a control parameter set to exactly 0.0 must be clamped to a negligible floor so the ablation is real.

studies.claim: The og-01/02/03 gates are vent-specific and falsifiable. A generic nonequilibrium control — the SAME real composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface and no pore concentration — is rejected by every discriminating gate (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Péclet, enrichment), while the vent passes all five. So a PASS elsewhere in the campaign certifies the vent MECHANISM, not merely "some nonequilibrium chemistry".

biological_validation.basis: The generic non-vent control is rejected by every discriminating gate, while the vent passes all five — the gates are vent-specific.

explanatory_gain.basis: Demonstrates falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the gates could have passed a feature-ablated control and did not.

derived.insight: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 vs 1e6 fold — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.
